newsitem.title: UK: Amoco seeks to invest in Romanian oil, gas sector.
newsitem.headline: Amoco seeks to invest in Romanian oil, gas sector.

text.p: U.S. oil giant Amoco Corp is looking to make a "substantial" investment in Romania's petroleum sector amounting to several million dollars, the company said on Friday.
Amoco is proposing to rework 20 oil and gas fields in cooperation with local companies Petrom and Romgaz.
The fields, which are predominatnly gas fields, are already operational, but Amoco and its partners believe output can be increased.

The president of Amoco Romania Petroleum Company said the company was hopeful the investment proposal would receive the government's go-ahead and that daily gas production could be increased before the end of the upcoming winter season.
A spokesman at the group's London office said Amoco was hopeful of a formal signing of the deal in early September.
